effect_modifiers.evidence: REML refit test of bbs(lprior, df=4): p=0.00027 at the main winsorization level, largest 0.00064 across levels [0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05]; centred effect -718 dollars at the 10th percentile of prior_earnings and 2,420 at the 90th

limited_overlap.description: applicants with prior earnings of at least 39,000 dollars: 3420 of 12000 program-year applicants, 63 of them enrolled (1.8%). Their effects are extrapolated from enrolled applicants with lower prior earnings.

605 of 4000 test applicants (15.1%) have a training-model enrolment probability below 0.02; 100% of them have prior earnings at or above 39,000 dollars. No training applicant with a comparable profile was enrolled often enough to measure their effect.

warnings: treatment (roles): CV mstop 1994 is at the edge of the grid
15.1% of test applicants have a propensity below 0.02
earnings are missing for 16.3% of training applicants; the estimates assume response is unrelated to earnings given enrolment and covariates
